items.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
items.body: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.

items.title: Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%
items.body: It put the U.K.'s annual inflation rate at a 1-year high.

items.title: Japan exports in October surge 20.5%, beating estimates on robust chip shipments
items.body: Semiconductor shipments spiked almost 50% year on year.

items.title: Analysis: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
items.body: Kevin Warsh sees AI at a turning point. He faces tough questions on jobs and interest rates.

items.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months
items.body: The forecast represents one of the most hawkish views among policymakers.

items.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
items.body: Energy subsidies for households had reportedly expired in September, exposing the economy to the higher energy prices brought about by the Iran war.

items.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
items.body: The report comes with Wall Street on edge over high-flying AI hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers.

items.title: Bessent blames Lutnick’s Commerce as he slams Nvidia chip ‘leakage’ to China
items.body: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO days after admitting to an affair following scrutiny of his relationship with a woman reportedly deemed a Chinese spy.
